title: [C&C] Free XP Titlers
description: Floating overhead titler synchronizing with your Experience Cloud level, active rank title (e.g. Initiate, Sovereign, Icon), Prestige star status, and weekly streak bonuses.

features.title: Live Cloud Rank Sync
features.desc: Automatically displays your real-time level and rank without manual notecard edits.

features.title: Prestige Stars & Streaks
features.desc: Visual badge markers for VIP and top-tier sim leaderboard players.

features.title: Color & Style Picker
features.desc: 12 velvet, obsidian, and champagne gold font styles.

features.title: 100% Free for Sim Visitors
features.desc: Claimable from the arrival terminal at Control & Chaos or on SL Marketplace.

sections.title: 1. How to Claim & Wear
sections.content: Claim the **[C&C] Free XP Titler** from the arrival landing point at Control & Chaos or order free on SL Marketplace. Right-click > Attach to **Avatar Center 2**.

sections.title: 2. Customization Commands
sections.content: Type `/11 titler menu` to change text colors, toggle prestige star icons, or switch to stealth mode.
